versions.name: A2B AD242x
versions.note: Second-generation AD242x family transceivers with expanded channels and diagnostics.

backward_compat_traps: Main and sub nodes must use a compatible A2B generation; mixing incompatible transceiver generations on one chain is not supported.
key_changes: AD242x expanded audio channel counts and diagnostics over AD2410.
GPIO-over-distance and enhanced line diagnostics in later parts.
fields.version_naming_history_note: Originally a Philips internal spec (1982); first public release v1.0 in 1992; NXP took ownership in 2006 when split from Philips. Recent versions are numbered as 'Rev. N' rather than 'vX.Y'.
